name: Lukewarm
overview: Scripture warns against being lukewarm in faith, highlighting a dangerous disconnect between profession and practice. The church at Sardis is described as having a reputation for life but is spiritually dead, and Laodicea is addressed by Christ as a church needing to strengthen what remains, indicating incomplete or imperfect works before God. Such lukewarmness reflects a denial of God in deeds despite claiming knowledge of Him, as seen in Titus, and is characterized by spiritual dullness and unresponsiveness. Salvation is found only in Christ, underscoring the urgency for genuine, fervent faith rather than complacency.
